messages:
maria-devex: Quick heads-up — proposing a safe rollout for a new runtime flag `route_by_cost` that routes non-critical requests to lower-cost model variants. Goal: cut token cost for background tasks without touching SLAs. Thoughts?

alex-platform: Sounds promising. Two immediate asks: per-tenant opt-out and a hard cap so we don't shift >10% of a customer's traffic without approval. :thumbsup:

jamal-sre: Need automatic rollback criteria. Suggest: if p50 latency for any region increases >30% or absolute p50 > 200ms for >5m, flip flag off. Also add a circuit-breaker metric and an alert.

anya-product: From console UX perspective we should show per-tenant rollout %, expected cost delta (est. $/1000 reqs), and annotate canary windows. Product also wants a quick "revert" button in the experiment panel.

carl-ml: Two model points: 1) quantized variants can change quality — require an eval-gate. 2) Pin variant to a model_version so we don't mix runtimes across rollouts. We should add a small gating config. Example config snippet:```yaml
feature: route_by_cost
params:
  default_percent: 0
  per_tenant_overrides: {}
  latency_slo_ms: 200
  rollback_window_minutes: 5
  telemetry_event: route_by_cost_eval
```

maria-devex: Proposed rollout flow: create flag in staging at 0%, run synthetic traffic + eval queries, open canary at 1% globally for 30m, then 5% for 2h if no regressions. API should accept overrides: {tenant_id, percent, expires_at}. Console must expose per-route toggles.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created feature flag `route_by_cost` in staging (0%) and wired telemetry -> dashboards/flags/route_by_cost (staging). Please add your test cases and synthetic job names.

alex-platform: I'll add a runtime guard: before switching model variant, check customer's quota_remaining and ensure we never divert >min(10%, quota_pct) for high-priority routes. Also add a route-level annotation in the API: `force_latency_sensitive: true`.

jamal-sre: Playbook snippet for alerts: "Alert: route_by_cost_circuit_open" when circuit_breaker_count > 0 for 3m. Run rollback hook: POST /internal/flags/rollback?flag=route_by_cost. Include runbook link in alert body.

maria-devex: Great. Next steps: I'll open a single PR that includes runtime flag handler + rollback hooks, a small eval-job, and console toggles with per-tenant override UI. I'll also draft the alert runbook. Assigning to alex and jamal for quota + alert reviews. :rocket: 

anya-product: Thanks — please tag product-analytics so they can surface cost delta in the billing preview.

carl-ml: I'll queue evals against the held-out set and add a quality threshold check. If quality drops >1.5% on key metrics, fail the canary.

maria-devex: Awesome. If nobody objects, I'll start the PR today and ping for code review.

alex-platform: No objections from me.

jamal-sre: 👍

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note: remember to run `./tools/flag-validate --schema route_by_cost` before promoting to prod.
